verifier: blind Claude agent re-implementation from the brief only; comparison computed by compare_independent.py (agent verification, not human)
ambiguities: Window uses calendar days from YYYYMMDD tourney_date; bounds d-1095<=d_m<d.
Unusable matches (W/O, pts2<=0, NaN svpt/1stIn/2ndWon) contribute nothing but still receive output rows.
Opponent's ret2 is computed over O's own window history at the same date d, not conditioned on P.
tm2 uses all usable rows of the same tour in window; NaN if empty.
Null score treated as not W/O. match_num cast to integer; k counted after dropping null rows.
Ratios with zero denominator -> NaN; all derived columns NaN if any input NaN.
Player ids cast to int via int64 (float ids in CSV).
